note: For normalized barycentric coordinates P=(x,y,z), the cevian lines are AD: z=(BD/DC)y; BE: x=(CE/EA)z; CF: y=(AF/FB)x. Positivity of all six subsegment lengths means a common point cannot have any of x,y,z equal to zero. Multiplication gives necessity. For sufficiency, with d=BD/DC, e=CE/EA, f=AF/FB and def=1, normalize the positive triple (ed,1,d); it satisfies all three line equations.
